evidence.excerpt: On LoCoEval (128 conversations, 12,780 turns), Pull reduces per-query context tokens (Phase 2) by 75.1 percent on single-hop tasks with equivalent quality ($Δ= -0.002$, n.s.) and by 72.0 percent on multi-hop tasks with no quality loss ($Δ= +0.017$).
